Until that fuse locks, the system keeps venting HORIZONTALLY (culture-war, geopolitical rivalry, elite-vs-elite faction conflict) because the privileged cage-holders remain aligned with the enclosure. The Turning's character (liberation vs recolonization) depends on whether vanguard alignment precedes or follows the legibility spark, and whether it is MEANINGFUL (structural, sustained) or SYMBOLIC (performative, one-off).
